description:
List all available service integration types for a project. Returns the integration type name along with the valid source and destination service types for each.

**Call this first** before creating an integration to understand which service types can be connected and in which direction.


This tool may return a long list; results support filtering and pagination to narrow large catalogs.

limit.description: Max items to return. Do NOT set this unless the user explicitly asked for a specific number of results.

offset.description: Number of items to skip for pagination. Use the value from the `next_offset` field in a previous response to fetch the next page.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring filter. Matches against `integration_type`. Only items containing this string are returned.

name: aiven_integration_types_list
title: Integration Types List
